Name: Mr.Qi and Fizz become Cute Spirits
Author: mintlemonsoda
Description:
I prefer Mr.Qi and Fizz to be something other than human, so I made this retexture mod to turn them into cute spirits. It also matches my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34988]retex for Qi bean[/url] better.

[b][size=3]Installation: [/size][/b]Download the file, unzip it and put it in the /Mods folder.

If you find any bugs or have any suggestions for improvement, feel free to contact me <3
